response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced (15+ years) and versatile full-stack/systems engineer with entrepreneurial credentials (GISCollective) and some very recent exposure to AI-agent tooling (MCP, agentic workflows) at re:cinq. However, the role requires a Director-level Principal Engineer with demonstrated AI/ML expertise, strategic customer advisory experience, and a track record of building recognized AI products or platforms — none of which is substantiated here. His career has been almost entirely hands-on IC work at Senior/Staff level, with no evidence of cloud/AI strategy work, executive-level influence, or thought leadership specifically in AI.
strengths: 15+ years of broad technical experience across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems
Entrepreneurial track record as founder of an open-source geo-data platform (GISCollective)
Current hands-on work on AI-agent infrastructure (MCP code generators, agentic frameworks) shows some AI engagement
concerns: No advanced degree or demonstrated deep AI/ML specialization required for this AI strategy role
No evidence of strategic customer/partner advisory experience or Director-level scope of influence
AI-related experience is very recent (since April 2025) and limited to tooling, not recognized AI products or platform-level innovation

key_factors.factor: Lack of AI/ML domain expertise and thought leadership
No strategic/executive-level customer advisory or director-scope experience
Broad, long-tenured engineering experience with entrepreneurial background
